event: Determine the relative position of the other person when the speech topic 'accepting snack offer (popcorn)' comes up.

sounding_object.description: A person with a blurred face, wearing a white t-shirt and light blue shorts, sitting at a wooden table.

reference_object.description: The camera itself, representing the wearer's point of view.

facing_object.description: Not applicable for egocentric mode where the camera's view is the reference for facing.

question: Imagine you are the camera wearer, when the speech topic "accepting snack offer (popcorn)" comes up, relative to where you are facing, where is the other person : left, right, or back? If the object is generally to your left and facing it requires turning less than 120 degrees left, choose 'left'. If the object is generally to your right and facing it requires turning less than 120 degrees right, choose 'right'. If the object is generally behind you and facing it requires turning 120 degrees or more, choose 'back'.
